triplets.head: NFT formation Step 1
triplets.tail: Hyperphosphorylation by overactive kinases + reduced PP2A → tau loses affinity for microtubules

triplets.head: NFT formation Step 2
triplets.tail: Detached tau destabilizes microtubules → disrupted axonal transport → synaptic starvation

triplets.head: NFT formation Step 3
triplets.tail: Free hyperphosphorylated tau sequesters normal tau and other MAPs; mislocalizes to somatodendritic compartment; undergoes conformational change

triplets.head: NFT formation Step 4
triplets.tail: Tau oligomer formation — considered the most toxic species

triplets.head: NFT formation Step 5
triplets.tail: Tau oligomers aggregate into paired helical filaments (PHFs) and straight filaments (SFs) via β-sheet formation

triplets.head: NFT formation Step 6
triplets.tail: PHFs/SFs accumulate to form neurofibrillary tangles (NFTs) filling cell body; after neuronal death become ghost tangles

triplets.head: Paired helical filaments
triplets.tail: Residues ~306–378 spanning R3 and R4 repeat domains
